Sources & calculation basis

Original Capped FY2026 uses Post Redistribution - Budget Monitoring 2026 - Division Breakdown - Original.xlsx / Consol by Division 2026.N. Distributed Capped FY2026 uses ... - Latest.xlsx / Consol by Division 2026. FY2027 uses submitted asks and the selected FY2026 commitment scope.

N/A and missing financial amounts are zero for reporting. Operating expenditure = source operating expenditure less depreciation. PBT = income − operating expenditure − financing cost − depreciation. FY2027 benchmark components = Distributed Capped FY2026 components × 1.10; benchmark PBT is calculated from those components. Original and Distributed source totals remain independent and are not forced to reconcile. Projected manpower is consolidated under Human Resources and projected depreciation under Finance, including saved adjustments.

Interest and Land sublease are combined as Land Lease; international and domestic travel as General and Admin (Travelling). Depreciation & Amortization maps to Depreciation; Impairment remains within operating totals. GL44000080 maps to Operating Grant (OE); GL44000090 to Development Grant (DE). Percentage = movement ÷ absolute Distributed comparator. Display rounding only.
